name: ARDENNE Aster: Sedan
description:
Introducing the Ardenne Aster, the debut model from ARDENNE, a luxury automotive marque built around timeless design, refined engineering, and an uncompromising attention to detail.

The Aster represents the beginning of a new era, a grand touring coupe designed for those who appreciate understated sophistication. Its sculpted silhouette, flowing body lines, and aerodynamic profile create a presence that feels both elegant and commanding, blending classic European luxury with modern performance aesthetics.
